findings.title: Negative queryset slice causes unhandled exception / DoS
findings.body: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result in src/sentry/api/paginator.py allows attacker-controlled negative offsets to reach Django ORM slicing: if enable_advanced_features and cursor.offset < 0 then start_offset = cursor.offset and results = list(queryset[start_offset:stop]). Cursor offsets come from the `cursor` query param via Cursor.from_string which does int(bits[1]) with no range check, so `cursor=0:-100:0` yields offset -100. Django QuerySets do not support negative slicing and raise AssertionError: Negative indexing is not supported. The code comment claiming the ORM properly handles negative slicing automatically is false. Consequence is an unhandled 500 instead of 400 BadPaginationError as used by OffsetPaginator/ChainPaginator, giving any user who can reach the optimized path a trivial DoS / error-probe vector.

findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator breaks datetime ordering
findings.body: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key in src/sentry/api/paginator.py does getattr(item, self.key) followed by math.floor/ceil, which only works for numeric keys. The only caller in src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py passes order_by="-datetime", so self.key is "datetime" and the value is a Python datetime. math.floor(datetime) raises TypeError. Similarly value_from_cursor returns raw cursor.value (int) while build_queryset expects a datetime for this ordering. Consequence is every request to the optimized_pagination path crashes with 500 instead of returning audit logs.

findings.title: Clamped offset not used consistently causes wrong page trimming
findings.body: BasePaginator.get_result in src/sentry/api/paginator.py now computes start_offset = max(0, offset) if not cursor.is_prev else offset and slices queryset[start_offset:stop], but the later is_prev trimming check still uses the original offset: elif len(results) == offset + limit + extra. When offset was negative and clamped to 0, or when is_prev allows a negative offset, the length comparison is off by the clamp amount. Consequence is incorrect dropping/keeping of the extra boundary row and incorrect has_results in the cursor, causing duplicate, missing, or oversized pages. The is_prev branch also still passes a potentially negative start to Django which raises AssertionError.

findings.title: Unsafe advanced pagination gated by overly broad check
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint.get in src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py enables the new negative-offset path when request.GET.get("optimized_pagination")=="true" and (request.user.is_superuser or organization_context.member.has_global_access), then passes enable_advanced_features=True. has_global_access is true for many non-owner roles and the raw GET param bypasses AuditLogQueryParamSerializer validation. Consequence is a much wider population than superusers can drive attacker-controlled cursors into the unsafe negative-slice code path described above, expanding DoS/crash exposure on the audit-log endpoint which previously used DateTimePaginator.
